newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex sees services demerger in H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Vendex sees services demerger in H1 1997.

text.p: Vendex chairman Jan-Michiel Hessels said on Monday a planned demerger and separate bourse listing of the group's business services division was expected to be completed by the end of the first half of 1997.

Hessels told a news conference that in the first phase of the demerger the group's shareholders would receive one "retail" share and one "business services" share in exchange for each of their existing Vendex shares.
Hessels said the bourse listing of the newly created business services company would be accompanied by an initial public offering of shares but gave no further details.

Vendex announced plans for a separate Amsterdam bourse listing for its business services division earlier on Monday along with a planned 2.5 billion franc takeover of French temporary employment agency BIS SA.
Vendex said that after the BIS takeover its business services division would rank third in Europe in temporary employment services and second in commercial cleaning.
